hosea.5.p1.b1.text: Hear this, O priests! Take heed, O house of Israel! Give ear, O royal house! … you have been a snare at Mizpah, a net spread out on Tabor.

hosea.5.p1.b2.text: They go with their flocks and herds to seek the LORD, but they do not find Him; He has withdrawn Himself from them.

hosea.5.p1.b3.text: Blow the ram’s horn in Gibeah, the trumpet in Ramah … Lead on, O Benjamin!

hosea.5.p1.b4.text: So I am like a moth to Ephraim, and like decay to the house of Judah.

hosea.5.p1.b5.text: When Ephraim saw his sickness … then Ephraim turned to Assyria and sent to the great king. But he cannot cure you or heal your wound.

hosea.5.p1.b6.text: For I am like a lion to Ephraim and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I, even I, will tear them to pieces and then go away. I will carry them off where no one can rescue them.

hosea.5.p1.b7.text: Then I will return to My place until they admit their guilt and seek My face; in their affliction they will earnestly seek Me.”
